title: Calycosin attenuates renal ischemia/reperfusion injury by suppressing NF-kappaB mediated inflammation via PPARgamma/EGR1 pathway.
authors: Zhang, Ningxin; Guan, Chen; Liu, Zengying; Li, Chenyu; Yang, Chengyu; Xu, Lingyu; Niu, Meng; Zhao, Long; Zhou, Bin; Che, Lin; Wang, Yanfei; Xu, Yan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究药物Calycosin通过PPARgamma/EGR1通路抑制NF-kappaB炎症减轻肾缺血再灌注损伤，虽涉及转录因子EGR1和PPARgamma，但核心是疾病药理机制，蛋白-DNA互作仅通过JASPAR预测和分子对接简单提及，无AI或物理模拟方法深度建模，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: Renal ischemia reperfusion injury (IRI) is a leading and common cause of acute kidney injury (AKI), and inflammation is a critical factor in ischemic AKI progression. Calycosin (CAL), a major active component of Radix astragali, has been reported to have anti-inflammatory effect in multiple organs. However, whether CAL can alleviate renal IRI and its mechanism remain uncertain. In the present study, a renal IRI model is established by bilateral renal pedicles occlusion for 35 min in male C57BL/6 mice, and the effect of CAL on renal IRI is measured by serum creatinine and pathohistological assay. Hypoxia/reoxygenation (H/R) stimulated human renal tubular epithelial cells HK-2 were applied to explore the regulatory mechanisms of CAL. Luciferase reporter assay and molecular docking were applied to identify the CAL's target protein and pathway. In the mice with renal IRI, CAL dose dependently alleviated the renal injury and decreased nuclear factor kappa B (NF-kappaB) mediated inflammatory response. Bioinformatics analysis and experiments showed that early growth response 1 (EGR1) increased in mice with renal IRI and promoted NF-kappaB mediated inflammatory processes, and CAL dose-dependably reduced EGR1. Through JASPAR database and luciferase reporter assay, peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor gamma (PPARgamma) was predicted to be a transcription factor of EGR1 and repressed the expression of EGR1 in renal tubular epithelial cells. CAL could increase PPARgamma in a dose dependent manner in mice with renal IRI and molecular docking predicted CAL could bind stably to PPARgamma. In HK-2 cells after H/R, CAL increased PPARgamma, decreased EGR1, and inhibited NF-kappaB mediated inflammatory response. However, PPARgamma knockdown by siRNA transfection abrogated the anti-inflammation therapeutic effect of CAL. CAL produced a protective effect on renal IRI by attenuating NF-kappaB mediated inflammatory response via PPARgamma/EGR1 pathway.
abstract_zh: 肾缺血再灌注损伤（IRI）是急性肾损伤（AKI）的主要且常见原因，而炎症是缺血性AKI进展中的关键因素。黄芪甲苷（CAL）是黄芪的主要活性成分，据报道在多个器官中具有抗炎作用。然而，CAL是否能缓解肾IRI及其机制仍不确定。本研究通过双侧肾蒂闭塞35分钟建立雄性C57BL/6小鼠肾IRI模型，并通过血清肌酐和组织病理学检测评估CAL对肾IRI的影响。采用缺氧/复氧（H/R）刺激的人肾小管上皮细胞HK-2来探讨CAL的调控机制。利用荧光素酶报告基因检测和分子对接鉴定CAL的靶蛋白及通路。在肾IRI小鼠中，CAL剂量依赖性地减轻肾损伤，并降低核因子κB（NF-kappaB）介导的炎症反应。生物信息学分析和实验表明，早期生长反应因子1（EGR1）在肾IRI小鼠中升高，并促进NF-kappaB介导的炎症过程，而CAL剂量依赖性地降低EGR1。通过JASPAR数据库和荧光素酶报告基因检测，过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体γ（PPARgamma）被预测为EGR1的转录因子，并在肾小管上皮细胞中抑制EGR1的表达。CAL在肾IRI小鼠中剂量依赖性地增加PPARgamma，分子对接预测CAL能稳定结合PPARgamma。在H/R后的HK-2细胞中，CAL增加PPARgamma，降低EGR1，并抑制NF-kappaB介导的炎症反应。然而，通过siRNA转染敲低PPARgamma后，CAL的抗炎治疗效果被消除。CAL通过PPARgamma/EGR1通路减轻NF-kappaB介导的炎症反应，从而对肾IRI产生保护作用。
